# Reeder LLP

> Los Angeles business litigation firm: trial and commercial litigation, corporate and transactional counsel, and related services for companies, investors, and individuals. The site describes a team-based, results-oriented practice led by trial lawyer Chris Reeder; practice-area pages describe a nationwide complex commercial trial and litigation practice.

- **Location (site):** 11766 Wilshire Blvd, Suite 1470, Los Angeles, CA 90025
- **Phone (site):** 310-861-2470

**Practice areas named on this site:** Trials and Commercial Litigation; Real Estate; Corporate; Franchise and Dealership; Entertainment; Sports; Employment; Intellectual Property; White Collar Crime / Investigations. The About page also describes general counsel–style work (e.g. M&A, financings, investigations, franchising, real estate, trademarks, compliance).
